body:
A mismatched expected frame must fail `mori test` while preserving the complete actual observations and continuing later stages and cases. This adds one public CLI regression for the existing disjoint composition consumer: one expected marker changes from 77 to 78, the command exits 1, and the entire failed aggregate plus all ten expanded reports remain equal to the frozen goldens.

Validation: the exact new test passed with `--no-default-features --features core2-disjoint-draft` (1 passed, 1 existing test filtered); rustfmt check passed. Source/tree and test inputs remained unchanged, the owned process session was empty and the temporary target was deleted. No production semantics changed. Independent source/result review is pending; shared-state composition, native proof and target acceptance remain open.

commits.messageHeadline: test: retain complete disjoint reports on expectation mismatch

title: Retain complete disjoint reports when an expected frame mismatches
